result:
The review is **incomplete**, so I can't approve it. I read all six full pages (scans 40–45) and all 18 enlarged bands, and compared every prayer word against the frozen readings. No word differs. I couldn't confirm every meteg, dagesh or holam at the resolution I had, and I found several issues that contradict the frozen readings. I couldn't check the frozen input's SHA256 because I had no hashing tool. Nothing was written.

The main problems:
- **Volume-one scan numbers:** all eight biblical/Mishnah citation labels, plus the Anna bekhoach attribution and acrostics, carry volume-one scan numbers (s54–s57). On these pages they actually appear on s40–s43.
- **Anna bekhoach attribution:** the page reads תפלת רבי נחוניה בן הקנה. The frozen file has תפלה … נחוניא, which looks like volume-one text.
- **Maqaf on scan 41:** I see a maqaf in אֶת־דָּמוֹ and עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ (Lev 1:11). The earlier source audit says, with high confidence, that there is none, and the frozen text follows it. I haven't overridden it; it needs a dedicated crop.
- **I couldn't find the 1007/1008 records**, so I've excluded every heading and rubric mark on these pages (listed in the JSON).
